Black luxury card - use for membership tier visual background
Dark blue/black fabric soft reflections - use as subtle background for specific dashboard widgets

instructions_to_main_agent: Install and use Outfit font from Google Fonts for all headings, Inter for body.
Implement pure HTML/Tailwind for marketing pages (Home, About, Plans). Heavy use of glassmorphism and the Tracing Beam effect for cards.
For Dashboard pages (User & Admin), use Shadcn components but heavily customize them with the glassmorphism and dark luxury theme provided.
Do NOT use pure white #FFFFFF for backgrounds. Stick strictly to #050505 as the base body background.
Use lucide-react for all icons, setting stroke widths to 1.5 for elegance.
Ensure the referral tree and task progress bars utilize the gold and purple gradients.
All cards must have a 1px border of white/10 (rgba(255,255,255,0.1)) to maintain the premium 'Crystal' glass look.
Use recharts for the profit analytics charts, with deep purple/gold strokes and transparent/glass tooltips.
Avoid the standard 'Vercel look' in Shadcn. Overwrite background classes to use black/40 and add subtle shadow glows on active states.
